s.t: A toy maker had one tin spoon.
s.fr: Un fabricant de jouets avait une cuillère en fer-blanc.

s.t: He melted the tin spoon over a fire.
s.fr: Il fit fondre la cuillère en fer-blanc sur un feu.

s.t: He poured the liquid tin into a mold.
s.fr: Il versa le fer-blanc liquide dans un moule.

s.t: The mold made one soldier.
s.fr: Le moule produisit un soldat.

s.t: 25 tin soldiers came from the mold.
s.fr: 25 soldats de fer-blanc sortirent du moule.

s.t: Each soldier held a small gun.
s.fr: Chaque soldat tenait un petit fusil.

s.t: The soldiers all looked the same.
s.fr: Les soldats se ressemblaient tous.

paras.summary: A toy maker melts a tin spoon, pours it into a mold, and makes 25 tin soldiers, each holding a small gun and looking just alike.

s.t: But there was no tin for the last one.
s.fr: Mais il n’y avait pas de fer-blanc pour le dernier.

s.t: That soldier got only one leg.
s.fr: Ce soldat n’eut qu’une seule jambe.

s.t: He stood on his one leg.
s.fr: Il se tenait sur sa seule jambe.

s.t: He stood as firm as his brothers.
s.fr: Il se tenait aussi ferme que ses frères.

s.t: The toy maker put the soldiers in a box.
s.fr: Le fabricant de jouets mit les soldats dans une boîte.

paras.summary: The last soldier gets only one leg for lack of tin, but stands as firm as his brothers, and the maker boxes them all.

s.t: A boy took the tin soldiers out of their box.
s.fr: Un garçon sortit les soldats de fer-blanc de leur boîte.

s.t: He set them in a row on a table.
s.fr: Il les plaça en rang sur une table.

s.t: Many other toys filled the table too.
s.fr: Beaucoup d’autres jouets remplissaient la table aussi.

s.t: A paper castle stood at one end.
s.fr: Un château de papier se dressait à un bout.

s.t: The castle had a door and small windows.
s.fr: Le château avait une porte et de petites fenêtres.

paras.summary: A boy takes the soldiers out and lines them up on a table full of toys, including a paper castle with a door and windows.

s.t: The other soldiers stood in pairs.
s.fr: Les autres soldats se tenaient par paires.

s.t: The last soldier had no partner.
s.fr: Le dernier soldat n’avait pas de partenaire.

s.t: He stood alone at the end of the row.
s.fr: Il se tenait seul à l’extrémité du rang.

s.t: From there, he could see the castle door.
s.fr: De là, il pouvait voir la porte du château.

paras.summary: The last soldier, with no partner, stands alone at the row's end, able to see the castle door.

s.t: A toy goblin sat on the table.
s.fr: Un lutin jouet était assis sur la table.

s.t: The toy goblin sat inside a little box.
s.fr: Le lutin jouet était assis à l’intérieur d’une petite boîte.

s.t: The little box had a lid.
s.fr: La petite boîte avait un couvercle.

paras.summary: A toy goblin sits on the table, inside a lidded little box.

s.t: A paper dancer stood at the castle door.
s.fr: Une danseuse en papier se tenait à la porte du château.

s.t: She had a dress.
s.fr: Elle avait une robe.

s.t: A shiny spangle was on her dress.
s.fr: Une paillette brillante était sur sa robe.

s.t: She held her arms out.
s.fr: Elle tendait ses bras en avant.

s.t: She lifted one leg.
s.fr: Elle leva une jambe.

paras.summary: A paper dancer stands at the castle door, her dress spangled, arms out and one leg lifted.

s.t: The tin soldier could see only her other leg.
s.fr: Le soldat de fer-blanc ne pouvait voir que son autre jambe.

s.t: He believed she had only one leg, like him.
s.fr: Il croyait qu’elle n’avait qu’une jambe, comme lui.

s.t: He loved her for this.
s.fr: Il l’aimait pour cela.

s.t: She had a castle.
s.fr: Elle avait un château.

s.t: He had only a box.
s.fr: Il avait seulement une boîte.

paras.summary: Believing she too has one leg, the soldier loves her, though she has a castle and he only a box.

s.t: The boy went to bed.
s.fr: Le garçon alla au lit.

s.t: The house was still.
s.fr: La maison était silencieuse.

s.t: The boy put the other soldiers in their box.
s.fr: Le garçon mit les autres soldats dans leur boîte.

s.t: But he forgot the last soldier on the table.
s.fr: Mais il oublia le dernier soldat sur la table.

paras.summary: The boy goes to bed, boxing the other soldiers but forgetting the last one on the table.

s.t: At night, the toys moved by themselves.
s.fr: La nuit, les jouets bougeaient d’eux-mêmes.

s.t: The boxed soldiers moved to come out.
s.fr: Les soldats en boîte bougèrent pour sortir.

s.t: But they could not open the lid.
s.fr: Mais ils ne pouvaient pas ouvrir le couvercle.

s.t: The tin soldier did not move.
s.fr: Le soldat de fer-blanc ne bougea pas.

paras.summary: At night the toys move, but the boxed soldiers can't escape, and the tin soldier stays still.

s.t: She stood on one leg all night.
s.fr: Elle se tint sur une jambe toute la nuit.

s.t: The tin soldier stood on his one leg too.
s.fr: Le soldat de fer-blanc se tint sur son unique jambe aussi.

s.t: He held his gun.
s.fr: Il tenait son fusil.

s.t: He watched her all night.
s.fr: Il la regarda toute la nuit.

paras.summary: The dancer stands on one leg all night, as does the soldier, watching her.

s.t: Midnight came.
s.fr: Minuit arriva.

s.t: The lid on the toy goblin's little box flew open.
s.fr: Le couvercle de la petite boîte du lutin jouet s’ouvrit d’un coup.

s.t: He jumped.
s.fr: Il sauta.

s.t: He sat near the castle.
s.fr: Il s’assit près du château.

s.t: The last soldier stood by the box.
s.fr: Le dernier soldat se tint près de la boîte.

s.t: The goblin looked at the last soldier.
s.fr: Le lutin regarda le dernier soldat.

s.t: The last soldier watched the paper dancer.
s.fr: Le dernier soldat observa la danseuse en papier.

paras.summary: At midnight, the goblin's box lid flies open and he jumps out to sit near the castle, looking at the last soldier, who watches the dancer.

s.t: "Stop looking at her," said the goblin.
s.fr: « Arrête de la regarder, » dit-il le lutin.

s.t: But the tin soldier said nothing.
s.fr: Mais le soldat de fer-blanc ne dit rien.

s.t: "You will be sorry tomorrow," said the goblin.
s.fr: « Tu seras désolé demain, » dit le lutin.

s.t: The tin soldier was not afraid.
s.fr: Le soldat de fer-blanc n’avait pas peur.

s.t: He watched the dancer.
s.fr: Il observa la danseuse.

paras.summary: The goblin warns him to stop looking or be sorry tomorrow, but the soldier, unafraid, says nothing and keeps watching.

s.t: Morning came.
s.fr: Le matin arriva.

s.t: The boy found the last soldier on the table.
s.fr: Le garçon trouva le dernier soldat sur la table.

s.t: He set the tin soldier in the window.
s.fr: Il plaça le soldat de fer-blanc dans la fenêtre.

s.t: The window of the house was high over the street.
s.fr: La fenêtre de la maison était haute au-dessus de la rue.

s.t: The wind blew hard.
s.fr: Le vent souffla fort.

s.t: The window flew open.
s.fr: La fenêtre s’ouvrit brusquement.

paras.summary: In the morning, the boy finds the last soldier and sets him in the high window, and a hard wind blows it open.

s.t: The tin soldier fell from the window.
s.fr: Le soldat de fer-blanc tomba de la fenêtre.

s.t: He fell all the way to the street.
s.fr: Il tomba jusqu’à la rue.

s.t: He landed between two stones.
s.fr: Il atterrit entre deux pierres.

s.t: His gun was stuck between the stones.
s.fr: Son fusil était coincé entre les pierres.

paras.summary: The soldier falls from the window, landing between two stones, his gun stuck fast.

s.t: The boy looked for the tin soldier.
s.fr: Le garçon chercha le soldat de fer-blanc.

s.t: A maid looked too.
s.fr: Une servante chercha aussi.

s.t: But they did not find him.
s.fr: Mais ils ne le trouvèrent pas.

paras.summary: The boy and a maid search but never find him.

s.t: Rain fell hard on the street.
s.fr: La pluie tomba fort sur la rue.

s.t: The tin soldier lay between the stones.
s.fr: Le soldat de fer-blanc resta entre les pierres.

s.t: Two boys came down the street.
s.fr: Deux garçons descendirent la rue.

s.t: They saw the tin soldier in the street.
s.fr: Ils virent le soldat de fer-blanc dans la rue.

s.t: "Look, a tin soldier," said one boy.
s.fr: « Regardez, un soldat de fer-blanc, » dit un garçon.

s.t: "Let's make him a boat," said the other boy.
s.fr: « Faisons-lui un bateau, » dit l’autre garçon.

paras.summary: Rain falls hard on the street where the soldier lies between two stones, and two passing boys spot him and decide to make him a boat.

s.t: The boys made a boat from paper.
s.fr: Les garçons fabriquèrent un bateau en papier.

s.t: They put the tin soldier inside the boat.
s.fr: Ils placèrent le soldat de fer-blanc à l’intérieur du bateau.

s.t: The boys ran with the boat to the gutter.
s.fr: Les garçons coururent avec le bateau jusqu’au caniveau.

s.t: They set it in the gutter.
s.fr: Ils le placèrent dans le caniveau.

s.t: It sailed down the gutter fast.
s.fr: Il navigua rapidement dans le caniveau.

paras.summary: The boys make a paper boat, put the soldier inside, and run it to the gutter, where it sails off fast.

s.t: But the tin soldier did not move.
s.fr: Mais le soldat de fer-blanc ne bougea pas.

s.t: He stood on his one leg inside the boat.
s.fr: Il se tint sur sa seule jambe à l’intérieur du bateau.

paras.summary: The soldier stands still on his one leg.

s.t: The boat sailed into a dark tunnel.
s.fr: Le bateau navigua dans un tunnel sombre.

s.t: It was as dark as his box.
s.fr: C’était aussi sombre que sa boîte.

s.t: The tin soldier believed the goblin did this.
s.fr: Le soldat de fer-blanc croyait que le lutin avait fait cela.

paras.summary: The boat enters a dark tunnel, and the soldier blames the goblin.

s.t: A big rat came into the tunnel.
s.fr: Un grand rat entra dans le tunnel.

s.t: The rat looked up at him.
s.fr: Le rat leva les yeux vers lui.

s.t: "You must pay a toll," said the rat.
s.fr: « Vous devez payer un péage, » dit-il le rat.

s.t: But the tin soldier said nothing.
s.fr: Mais le soldat de fer-blanc ne dit rien.

s.t: He held his gun hard.
s.fr: Il tenait son fusil fermement.

s.t: The rat could not stop him.
s.fr: Le rat ne pouvait pas l’arrêter.

paras.summary: A big rat demands a toll in the tunnel, but the soldier stays silent, holds his gun firm, and the rat cannot stop him.

s.t: The boat sailed on fast.
s.fr: Le bateau continua à naviguer vite.

s.t: Ahead, the tin soldier saw the way out.
s.fr: Devant lui, le soldat de fer-blanc vit la sortie.

paras.summary: The fast boat nears the way out.

s.t: The boat came out of the tunnel.
s.fr: Le bateau sortit du tunnel.

s.t: It sailed into a big canal.
s.fr: Il navigua dans un grand canal.

s.t: The canal water was fast.
s.fr: L’eau du canal était rapide.

s.t: The boat spun around and around.
s.fr: Le bateau tourna encore et encore.

s.t: Water filled the boat.
s.fr: L’eau remplit le bateau.

paras.summary: The boat leaves the tunnel into a fast canal, spinning around and around as water fills it.

s.t: The paper broke a little.
s.fr: Le papier se déchira un peu.

s.t: The tin soldier stood in the water.
s.fr: Le soldat de fer-blanc se tenait dans l’eau.

s.t: The water was up to his neck.
s.fr: L’eau lui arrivait jusqu’au cou.

s.t: He believed he would not see her again.
s.fr: Il croyait qu’il ne la reverrait plus.

paras.summary: The paper breaks, and as water rises to his neck, he believes he'll never see her again.

s.t: The boat broke.
s.fr: Le bateau se brisa.

s.t: He sank into the water.
s.fr: Il coula dans l’eau.

paras.summary: The boat breaks; he sinks.

s.t: A big fish came by.
s.fr: Un grand poisson passa.

s.t: It swallowed the tin soldier.
s.fr: Il avala le soldat de fer-blanc.

s.t: Inside the fish, it was dark.
s.fr: À l’intérieur du poisson, il faisait sombre.

s.t: It was as dark as the tunnel and his box.
s.fr: C’était aussi sombre que le tunnel et sa boîte.

paras.summary: A big fish swallows him; inside it is as dark as his box.

s.t: The last soldier lay down inside the fish.
s.fr: Le dernier soldat s’allongea à l’intérieur du poisson.

s.t: The toy soldier thought of the paper dancer.
s.fr: Le soldat de jouet pensa à la danseuse de papier.

paras.summary: He lies inside the fish, thinking of the dancer.

s.t: The fish swam in the sea.
s.fr: Le poisson nagea dans la mer.

s.t: Days passed.
s.fr: Des jours passèrent.

s.t: At last, the fish was still.
s.fr: Enfin, le poisson était immobile.

paras.summary: The fish swims on for days, then stills.

s.t: One day, a man caught the fish.
s.fr: Un jour, un homme attrapa le poisson.

s.t: "What a big fish!" said the man.
s.fr: « Quel grand poisson ! » dit-il.

s.t: He sold it at a market.
s.fr: Il le vendit dans un marché.

paras.summary: A man catches the fish one day and sells it at market.

s.t: A cook came to the market.
s.fr: Une cuisinière vint au marché.

s.t: She bought the fish.
s.fr: Elle acheta le poisson.

s.t: The cook was from the same house.
s.fr: La cuisinière venait de la même maison.

paras.summary: A cook from the same house buys the fish at market.

s.t: She went to the kitchen.
s.fr: Elle alla à la cuisine.

s.t: She cut the fish open.
s.fr: Elle ouvrit le poisson en le coupant.

s.t: Inside, she found the last soldier.
s.fr: À l’intérieur, elle trouva le dernier soldat.

s.t: He still held his gun.
s.fr: Il tenait encore son fusil.

s.t: But he did not move.
s.fr: Mais il ne bougea pas.

paras.summary: In the kitchen she cuts the fish open, finding the soldier still holding his gun.

s.t: The cook was very surprised.
s.fr: La cuisinière était très surprise.

s.t: She took him to the boy's room.
s.fr: Elle l’emmena dans la chambre du garçon.

s.t: She put him near the castle.
s.fr: Elle le posa près du château.

paras.summary: Surprised, the cook takes him to the boy's room.

s.t: The tin soldier was on the table again.
s.fr: Le soldat de fer-blanc était de nouveau sur la table.

s.t: The same paper castle stood there.
s.fr: Le même château de papier se trouvait là.

s.t: The same dancer stood at the door.
s.fr: La même danseuse se tenait à la porte.

s.t: She still stood on one leg.
s.fr: Elle tenait encore sur une jambe.

s.t: The tin soldier still held his gun.
s.fr: Le soldat de fer-blanc tenait encore son fusil.

paras.summary: The soldier is back on the same table, with the same castle and dancer, still on one leg and holding his gun.

s.t: He watched her.
s.fr: Il la regardait.

s.t: She looked at him.
s.fr: Elle le regardait.

s.t: The tin soldier was glad to see her.
s.fr: Le soldat de fer-blanc était content de la voir.

s.t: He thought of his box.
s.fr: Il pensa à sa boîte.

s.t: But they said nothing.
s.fr: Mais ils ne dirent rien.

s.t: The boy came to see the tin soldier.
s.fr: Le garçon vint voir le soldat de fer-blanc.

s.t: He did not know of the fish.
s.fr: Il ne savait pas que le poisson existait.

paras.summary: Watching each other and glad to be reunited, they say nothing, and the boy, not knowing of the fish, comes to see the soldier.

s.t: One day, a boy took the tin soldier.
s.fr: Un jour, un garçon prit le soldat de fer-blanc.

s.t: He threw the tin soldier into the stove.
s.fr: Il jeta le soldat de fer-blanc dans le poêle.

s.t: No one knew why.
s.fr: Personne ne savait pourquoi.

s.t: Perhaps the toy goblin was behind it.
s.fr: Peut-être que le lutin jouet était derrière cela.

paras.summary: One day a boy throws him into the stove for no known reason, perhaps the goblin's doing.

s.t: The tin soldier stood in the fire.
s.fr: Le soldat de fer-blanc se tenait dans le feu.

s.t: He did not let go of his gun.
s.fr: Il ne lâcha pas son fusil.

s.t: The tin soldier melted.
s.fr: Le soldat de fer-blanc fondit.

s.t: Perhaps it was the fire, or his love.
s.fr: C’était peut-être le feu, ou son amour.

paras.summary: The soldier stands in the fire, still gripping his gun, and melts, whether from heat or love.

s.t: A door opened.
s.fr: Une porte s’ouvrit.

s.t: A draft blew the paper dancer into the stove.
s.fr: Un courant d’air souffla la danseuse en papier dans le poêle.

s.t: She was gone.
s.fr: Elle avait disparu.

paras.summary: The dancer is blown into the stove and gone.

s.t: In the morning, the maid came to the stove.
s.fr: Le matin, la servante vint au poêle.

s.t: She found a little tin heart in the ashes.
s.fr: Elle trouva un petit cœur de fer-blanc dans les cendres.

s.t: Of the dancer, only the spangle was left.
s.fr: De la danseuse, il ne restait que la paillette.

s.t: It was burnt black.
s.fr: Elle était toute noircie.

paras.summary: The maid finds a tin heart in the ashes; only a burnt spangle remains of the dancer.
